start.speaker: John Pork
start.text: HEY-O! Welcome to John Pork's Disc-Side Concessions! Cold drinks, hot dogs, and party favors. No cash, no cards - scrap only. Money's dead. Scrap metal is forever.

choices.text: Why set up at a disc golf course?

menu.speaker: John Pork
menu.text: What else can I do ya for?

choices.text: Why set up at a disc golf course?

shop_food.speaker: John Pork
shop_food.text: Fuel for the back nine. Everything's warm except the water, and the water's room temperature, which is a kind of warm.

choices.text: 1 scrap metal for 3 bottles of water.
1 scrap metal for 2 gas station hot dogs.
1 scrap metal for 2 bags of pork rinds.
1 duct tape for 2 corn dogs and 2 waters.

shop_booze.speaker: John Pork
shop_booze.text: Coolers are full, ice is a memory. Drink responsibly. Or don't, I'm not your dad.

choices.text: 1 scrap metal for 2 Platte Valley Lights.
1 duct tape for 2 IPAs and a stout.
1 scrap metal for a 3-pack of hard seltzers.
1 duct tape for a round of shots.
1 wrench for jungle juice and a Long Island.
1 car battery for the party pack.

shop_party.speaker: John Pork
shop_party.text: *looks both ways* ...I got a guy at UNK. Don't tell him what I charge, he thinks I'm his only customer.

choices.text: 2 scrap metal for an acid tab.
1 car battery for... the heavy stuff.

sold_water.speaker: John Pork
sold_water.text: Three waters. Hydrate or diedrate. That's the slogan. I'm workshopping it.

sold_dogs.speaker: John Pork
sold_dogs.text: Two dogs, been rolling on the roller since before the bombs. Seasoned by time itself.

sold_rinds.speaker: John Pork
sold_rinds.text: John's Pork Rinds! Family recipe. Don't ask which family.

sold_corn.speaker: John Pork
sold_corn.text: Corn dogs! Nebraska's finest export. Corn. On a dog. On a stick.

sold_light.speaker: John Pork
sold_light.text: Platte Valley Light. Tastes like a river. A refreshing river.

sold_lager.speaker: John Pork
sold_lager.text: Sandhills Lager. Brewed out west by a guy named Dale. Dale's gone now. The lager remains.

sold_craft.speaker: John Pork
sold_craft.text: Couple of IPAs and a stout. For the disc golfer with a beard and opinions.

sold_seltzer.speaker: John Pork
sold_seltzer.text: Black cherry, lime, mango. Basically water. Do NOT treat it like water.

sold_shots.speaker: John Pork
sold_shots.text: Whiskey, vodka, tequila, cinnamon. A shot for every bad decision you're about to make.

sold_mixed.speaker: John Pork
sold_mixed.text: Jungle juice and a Long Island. What's in the jungle juice? Yes.

sold_party_pack.speaker: John Pork
sold_party_pack.text: THE PARTY PACK. Boxed wine, a jar of moonshine, four warm tallboys. God bless.

sold_kush.speaker: John Pork
sold_kush.text: Two joints. Smoke 'em AFTER your round. Or during. You'll putt like a monk.

sold_shrooms.speaker: John Pork
sold_shrooms.text: Mushrooms. The baskets start talking around hole six. Listen to them.

sold_acid.speaker: John Pork
sold_acid.text: One tab. The trees out here are a LOT on acid. Just so you know.

sold_molly.speaker: John Pork
sold_molly.text: Molly. You're gonna wanna hug the chains. Let yourself.

sold_tar.speaker: John Pork
sold_tar.text: ...Here. Look, I sell it 'cause people want it, not 'cause it's good. Go slow. Come back and buy a hot dog after, okay?

broke.speaker: John Pork
broke.text: Ope - you're short, buddy. Scrap, tape, wrenches, car batteries. Bring me junk, I bring you joy.

who.speaker: John Pork
who.text: John Pork. Ran the concession stand at the ballfields before everything ended. Everything ended, the concessions didn't. Somebody's gotta keep the people fed and hammered.

pork.speaker: John Pork
pork.text: It's my NAME, man. Like Smith. Like Baker. My great-granddad raised hogs out by Gibbon. And no - I don't answer my phone. Phones don't work anyway. Stop calling.

why.speaker: John Pork
why.text: Disc golfers are the last civilization. Zombies, raiders, the sky going weird - they're still out here, throwing plastic at chains, keeping score. Respect. Also they're always thirsty.

tips.speaker: John Pork
tips.text: Check the board - see who's got the records. Wind changes every half minute, so watch the arrow. And if you go in the water, you throw again from where it went in, plus one. Don't drink before you putt. Okay, drink a little.

shop_discs.speaker: John Pork
shop_discs.text: Hand-pressed, prairie-tested, only slightly irradiated. Base plastic slips when you throw it and beats in fast. Premium grips and holds its line. Bottle caps only - discs are serious business.

broke_caps.speaker: John Pork
broke_caps.text: Ope - not enough caps, buddy. Bottle caps. Little metal hats. Check every cooler in Kearney.

sold_disc_comet_premium.text: One Platte Comet (Premium). Treat her right and she'll treat you right.
